lead.headline: Tankers Hit Mines in Strait of Hormuz as Iran Talks Continue and Post-Midterm Strike Fears Grow
lead.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz. The claim disputes U.S. statements that the key shipping lanes had been cleared. Houthi forces also claimed a new wave of attacks on Saudi airports and oil sites. Diplomacy is continuing alongside the violence, and a Qatari delegation is in Tehran. Fears are growing that U.S. strikes could resume after the midterm elections.
lead.deck: Iran says four tankers struck mines in the strait, disputing U.S. claims that shipping lanes had been cleared.

tech.headline: Nvidia Moves to Backstop Cloud Provider's $45 Billion Anthropic Project
tech.summary: Nvidia is in talks to give Nscale, a young AI cloud provider, billions of dollars in credit guarantees for debt. The money would fund a 460-megawatt data center that Anthropic plans to use, according to The Information.

tech.headline: Roblox Shares Tumble After Fourth-Quarter Outlook Disappoints
tech.summary: Roblox shares fell as much as 21% on Friday after the company gave a weak fourth-quarter sales outlook. Bloomberg reported that user growth slowed and missed estimates despite a hit game.

tech.headline: Nasdaq Suffers Worst Day Since June as Investors Dump Tech Shares
tech.summary: The Nasdaq lost 2.86% and closed at 25,437.00, its worst single-day performance since June. Investors dumped tech shares on worries about AI spending.

business.headline: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles, Intel Drops 29% as AI Spending Fails to Reassure Investors
business.summary: A deep sell-off in technology stocks capped a third straight weekly loss for the Nasdaq 100. Bloomberg reported that investors who stayed all-in on the AI trade were hit hard as the companies at its center fell one after another. AP reported the S&P 500 fell 1.8%, its worst day since June.

business.headline: Exxon and Chevron Hit Record Highs as War-Driven Refining Profits Soar
business.summary: Exxon Mobil and Chevron both reported third-quarter earnings above Wall Street estimates, helped by strong refining margins tied to the Iran and Ukraine wars. Chevron's CEO told CNBC that the system is under stress.

business.headline: Reddit, Pinterest and Roblox Stocks Tank After Third-Quarter Earnings
business.summary: Reddit shares plunged roughly 25% to 29% on Friday after its quarterly report, as user growth and its outlook disappointed. Roblox and Pinterest also fell.

world.headline: Hegseth Removes Top General, Accusing Him of Leaking Classified War Information
world.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth abruptly removed a top general. He accused him of leaking classified information about the wars in Iran and Ukraine, amid a federal investigation, NBC News reported.

world.headline: Trump Reverses Course and Reinstates Cancelled Campaign Rallies
world.summary: President Trump reinstated campaign rallies he had cancelled. Republican officials have not ruled out adding another event before the midterm election.

sports.headline: Warriors Beat Lakers 112-95
sports.summary: Golden State beat the Los Angeles Lakers 112-95 on Friday, October 30, according to ESPN's final score.

sports.headline: Baylor Routs UCF 41-9 in Interim Coach's Debut
sports.summary: DJ Lagway threw for 319 yards and four touchdowns as Baylor beat UCF 41-9 on Friday night. It was Klanderman's first game as interim coach.

sports.headline: Magic Top Raptors 121-114 in Toronto
sports.summary: Orlando beat Toronto 121-114 on Friday, October 30, according to the CBS Sports schedule page.
